kaisa_nyberg.title: Kaisa Nyberg
kaisa_nyberg.subtitle: Cryptography · Computer Science
kaisa_nyberg.body: Kaisa Nyberg is Professor Emerita of Cryptology at Aalto University. She led the Cryptography research group in the Department of Computer Science until 2016. Her work connects mathematical cryptography with the protection of information and digital communication.
kaisa_nyberg.task: Think about it: which parts of a secure phone message might depend on cryptography?

erkki_oja.title: Erkki Oja
erkki_oja.subtitle: Machine Learning · Neural Networks
erkki_oja.body: Erkki Oja is Professor Emeritus of Computer Science and Engineering at Aalto University. His research includes neural networks, unsupervised learning, statistical pattern recognition, computer vision, and signal and data analysis. He is also known for Oja's learning rule and pioneering work in machine learning.
erkki_oja.task: Think about it: how can a machine learn useful structure without being given every answer?

hans_andersin.title: Hans Andersin
hans_andersin.subtitle: Computing · Technology Education
hans_andersin.body: Hans Andersin (1930–2010) was a Finnish computing pioneer and professor at Helsinki University of Technology. He helped introduce computer technology and computing education in Finland, and served as the first professor of computer science at the university from 1968.
hans_andersin.task: Think about it: what changes when a new technology becomes part of university teaching?

teuvo_kohonen.title: Teuvo Kohonen
teuvo_kohonen.subtitle: Neural Networks · Self-Organizing Maps
teuvo_kohonen.body: Teuvo Kohonen (1934–2021) was an Academician and Professor Emeritus whose work helped put Finnish artificial intelligence research on the world map. He is best known for self-organizing maps, neural networks, associative memories, and pattern recognition.
teuvo_kohonen.task: Think about it: how could similar data points be arranged on a two-dimensional map?
